_doc: v6 footage slots (docs/treatment_v6.md shot list). desc = what Jade does; standin = an existing take used until her footage arrives (tools/footage/standins.py extracts it from review/takes/ or the box's media/gen/; s0 = the song time of its frame 0 when it was made against this song). A slot without a stand-in draws a labelled card. The real footage wins as soon as tools/footage/sync.py + prep.py have put it in work/footage/.

W.desc: the girl at the frost window (existing window takes, box only)

W2.desc: the girl blows on her palm at the window (existing take, box only)

A1.desc: close-up, head and shoulders, centred: sing the whole song to the lens

A2.desc: medium, waist up, right third: sing the whole song

A3.desc: wide, full body, centred, stay in one spot: sing the whole song (the crowd source)

A4.desc: wide, from behind: stand, slow head turn; walk away 5 steps

A5.desc: close profile facing left, eyes closed: sing the breakdown

A6.desc: overhead, lying back, arms out, eyes closed (optional)

B1.desc: close 3/4 profile: blow across the open palm, watch it drift (60 fps)

B2.desc: cupped hands hold a light, open, follow it up past the lens

B3.desc: look left of lens; on the clap turn to look past camera right, hold (per life outfit)

B4.desc: fold: reach to the lens, draw back, cross hands to chest

B5.desc: catch: eyes closed, hands to chest, a breath, eyes open

B6.desc: bun + two pencils: pull a pencil from the bun, write a line in the air

B7.desc: bun, seated, cool side light: look up and out, sing verse 2

B8.desc: bun: a light over the open palm drifts to the horizon; watch it go

B9.desc: wide, front-on: step in from the side into the closing posture, salute on the ooh

C1.desc: piano: hands on the keys, then a wide at the piano

C2.desc: violin: close on the fingerboard (red tape), then at the shoulder

C3.desc: acoustic guitar: strumming, close on the hand, then medium

C4.desc: poet: writing a line with a pencil in a notebook

C5.desc: stage: typing on a laptop, then turning to talk to an audience

C6.desc: home: hands move a ball around a light (Copernican model); hands only, no kids

C7.desc: wushu: a held stance and one clean move

C8.desc: lab / PhD / NASA: a pipette, headphones or a model plane

C9.desc: mic (jade/rare-earth): sing one chorus into the mic, 3/4 angle

H1.desc: the hero shot, unprocessed: flat horizon at sunrise, sing 235.7-256

H2.desc: wide from behind at the water's edge, still, 30 s

R1.desc: the 2004 group set, traced (box: ?drop=real); stand-in = the solo long fist, copied
